접촉 도구는 폴리머 레코드 잔기만 검사하므로 HETATM 변형 잔기는 검사하지 않는다.
reference_statement: Accessions, UniProt positions, KLIFS pocket numbers and labels, and the structure residue a numbering map row assigns each number to are reference snapshot values (참조 스냅샷 값, 계산 아님), not ProtView calculations. ProtView computed only the per-site geometric contact counts and minimum distances from the stored contact rows, and the site counts.
